market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil above $100 and yields near 5% create a stagflationary pressure. S&P likely to test lower supports. Fed hike bets and inflation data (3.7%) limit central bank flexibility. Trade war with Canada adds policy uncertainty. Watch for 10Y breaking decisively above 5%.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil stabilizes below $100 and Fed pivots. AI capex cycle (Broadcom 2028 guidance, CoreWeave demand, Berkshire/Google) provides structural growth. However, sustained inflation and trade fragmentation cap multiples. Favor quality, cash-flow-generative names over speculative growth.
